cards.t: Cardano Tapped by Petrobras for Fuel Tracking
cards.b: Brazil's state-owned energy giant Petrobras is testing Cardano-based applications to track sustainable aviation fuel and diesel data, aiming to prevent double-counting of emissions benefits.

per.ADA: Enterprise adoption validation by a major national oil company offers strong fundamental backing.

cards.t: Bitget Hackers Move Funds to Zcash Private Pool
cards.b: The exploiters behind the massive Bitget breach have begun routing stolen funds into Zcash's privacy features following blocked swaps on other chains, driving transactional focus to privacy coins.

per.ZEC: On-chain activity spike driven by high-profile fund laundering highlights core privacy utility.

cards.t: Bitwise Launches US Spot NEAR ETF
cards.b: Bitwise has rolled out the first U.S. spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca, capitalizing on strong recent token momentum and expanding network activity across NEAR Intents.

per.NEAR: Regulated ETF vehicle entry expands institutional accessibility and visibility.

cards.t: Kakaopay Partners with Ondo and Dinari for Tokenization
cards.b: Kakaopay Securities is collaborating with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore the tokenization of Korean-listed equities for international market participants.

per.ONDO: Real-world asset tokenization narrative continues to secure major international fintech partnerships.

cards.t: Standard Chartered Predicts USDe Scale and ENA Target
cards.b: Standard Chartered has issued an aggressive growth outlook for Ethena, projecting USDe scale to reach $40B and ENA to climb toward $2 alongside expanding token buybacks.

per.ENA: Institutional bullish forecasts provide structural tailwinds for DeFi yield and synthetic dollar assets.

cards.t: Base Deploys Cobalt Upgrade for Tokenized Assets
cards.b: Base has completed its Cobalt upgrade, introducing advanced conditional transaction tools and compliance features tailored for tokenized real-world assets and issuers.

per.ETH: Layer-2 structural upgrades enhance institutional readiness for native asset issuance.
